title: Archetype test: which of the 12 archetypes are you? Jung-inspired free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free archetype test inspired by Carl Jung: answer 12 questions to find which of the 12 archetypes you are: Innocent, Everyman, Hero, Caregiver, Explorer, Rebel, Lover, Creator, Jester, Sage, Magician or Ruler. No sign-up.
h1: Which of the 12 archetypes are you?
lede: The Hero, the Sage, the Rebel or the Jester? Answer 12 questions about what drives you, what you fear and how you treat others to find the archetype that fits your story.
about: Psychiatrist Carl Jung described archetypes as universal patterns, characters that turn up in myths and stories all over the world. Later writers, notably Carol S. Pearson and Margaret Mark in their book The Hero and the Outlaw (2001), turned the idea into the twelve archetypes widely used today in storytelling, marketing and self-reflection: the Innocent, Everyman, Hero, Caregiver, Explorer, Rebel, Lover, Creator, Jester, Sage, Magician and Ruler. Each is defined by a core desire and a core fear.

This quiz matches you with the archetype you chose most and shows your scores for all twelve. The questions were written for cv.cm from that twelve-archetype model; they are not taken from any published inventory, and the result is a lens for reflection, not a scientific measure of personality. If you'd like a research-based personality test, try the Big Five on this site.

faq.a: The Innocent, Everyman, Hero, Caregiver, Explorer, Rebel (also called the Outlaw), Lover, Creator, Jester, Sage, Magician and Ruler.

Not exactly. Jung wrote about archetypes such as the Hero, the Wise Old Man and the Trickster. The set of twelve used here was developed later by writers building on his ideas, especially Carol S. Pearson and Margaret Mark.

faq.q: Is one archetype rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every archetype appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.
No. Archetypes are a storytelling tool, not a validated personality model. Your answers stay in your browser.

innocent.name: The Innocent
innocent.body: You are optimistic, honest and trusting. You want a simple, good life and you bring hope wherever you go. Your faith in people is a gift; just keep your eyes open, because not everyone shares your good intentions.

everyman.name: The Everyman
everyman.body: You are down to earth, friendly and fair. You want to belong and you make others feel they belong too. You're the dependable friend with no airs. Don't be afraid to stand out sometimes; your voice deserves to be heard.

hero.name: The Hero
hero.body: You are brave, determined and driven to prove yourself. You rise to challenges and fight for what's right. Your courage inspires others; remember that rest and asking for help are not weakness.

caregiver.name: The Caregiver
caregiver.body: You are generous, compassionate and protective. You want to help others and you notice when someone is struggling. Just make sure you include yourself in the list of people you look after.

explorer.name: The Explorer
explorer.body: You are independent, curious and restless. You want freedom and new experiences, and you're happiest on an unknown road. Your hunger to discover keeps you growing; just remember to come home to the people who matter.

rebel.name: The Rebel
rebel.body: You are bold, unconventional and unafraid to break rules that don't make sense. You want change and you speak up for it. Your fire can shake things up for the better; aim it at what truly needs to change.

lover.name: The Lover
lover.body: You are passionate, warm and devoted. You care about closeness, beauty and the people you love. Your relationships are deep and rich; keep a strong sense of who you are, too.

creator.name: The Creator
creator.body: You are imaginative, expressive and driven to make things. You want to create something of lasting value. Your vision is your gift; don't let perfectionism keep your work hidden.

jester.name: The Jester
jester.body: You are playful, funny and spontaneous. You want to enjoy life and help others lighten up. Your humor heals; just let people see your serious side sometimes too.

sage.name: The Sage
sage.body: You are thoughtful, wise and curious about how the world really works. You want truth and understanding, and people come to you for advice. Remember that knowing is most useful when you act on it.

magician.name: The Magician
magician.body: You are visionary, charismatic and drawn to transformation. You want to make dreams real and change things at their root. Your ideas can move people; use that power wisely.

ruler.name: The Ruler
ruler.body: You are responsible, organized and a natural leader. You want stability and you take charge to create it. People feel safe with you in control; remember to listen and share power, too.
